gloss: home video game console; stationary console

definitions.gloss: home video game console (as opposed to a handheld)
definitions.explanation: A game console that stays in one place and is connected to a television, contrasted with a handheld console that can be carried around.

examples.japanese: {据|す}え{置|お}き{機|き}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: to play games on a home console

examples.japanese: {据|す}え{置|お}き{機|き}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{携帯機|けいたいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}べる→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
examples.english: Games that can be played on both home consoles and handhelds are popular.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つなぐ{据|す}え{置|お}き{機|き}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: These days more people play games on their smartphones than on home consoles connected to a TV.

notes:
From ⟦{据|す}え{置|お}く→据え置く：18383_sueoku⟧ (to set in place) + 〜⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧ (machine). A gamers' and industry word; in general writing the fuller ⟦{家庭用|かていよう}ゲーム{機|き}→家庭用ゲーム機：23658_kateiyougeemuki⟧ is common.
